collection-mercy-07.title: Sharing another person's joy
collection-mercy-07.alt: A woman applauds a smiling graduate who holds flowers and a folder, with others celebrating behind them.
collection-mercy-07.caption: One woman's accomplishment is welcomed with another's applause. This imagined scene of a sister celebrating a graduation offers a question alongside the elder son's story: can we make room for someone else's joy? The connection concerns our response to celebration, not an equation between graduation and repentance.
